text_block_list.text:
The New Year of the Senior Year had 
finally arrived. With our major spring 
objective, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, just 
around the corner—

After the New Year's holidays, K.S. 
Miracle returned from her family home to 
the academy, and we went on our first 
shrine visit of the year together to pray 
for victory.
...Or so I thought, but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: ...Miracle? Are you okay?
...Miracle? You okay?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry. I totally spaced out...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, the line to pray... seems pretty 
empty now. ...Shall we go?"

K.S. Miracle's pace as she headed to pray 
was somewhat sluggish. ...Come to think of 
it, she had been like that ever since we 
met up this morning.
choice_data_list: (Could she be feeling sick somewhere...?)

text_block_list.text:
Although we finished our shrine visit 
properly for now, I couldn't help but 
worry about K.S. Miracle as she prayed 
beside me.

Was she just tired from just getting back 
home? Or maybe the meetup time was a bit 
too early?
choice_data_list: (Hmm, or maybe...)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I caused trouble again—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's not it? Um... I'm making you 
worry, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I'll explain properly. It's 
really not that big of a deal, though."

"And so, K.S. Miracle stepped slightly 
away from the bustling shrine and quietly, 
slowly opened up to me."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm... not very good with winter, to be 
honest.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I hate the cold, but... when 
the temperature drops, I often get dazed 
and sleepy, and end up moving really slow.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, but... I can endure it. Usually, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Usually it's... but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um... I'm sorry. ...Walking next to 
you, Trainer, it's just, well...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...All fluffy-wuffy...? I feel so...
choice_data_list: So fluffy...

text_block_list.text:
After reflexively parroting her words 
back, I let out a soft chuckle. Partly 
because the utterly adorable sound of it 
was funny, and partly... because it made 
me feel strangely relieved.

Because it deeply touched me that you 
opened up to me like that, and came to 
feel that way about it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry. I just said something really 
weird, didn't I—
choice_data_list: No. ...More importantly, Miracle,
No. ...More importantly, Miracle...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Pardon? ...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wa... ah, huh? Trainer, this is... This is 
your scarf, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
If you're not good with the cold, you can 
borrow this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, if that's the case, Trainer will—
choice_data_list: I'm actually pretty sensitive to heat...
Actually, I get hot pretty easily~

text_block_list.text:
...It's not particularly the case, but 
let's just pretend it was for now. She 
exaggeratedly fanned at her neck.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

K.S.Miracle looked very... very, very much 
like she wanted to say something, but for 
the time being, she quietly accepted it.

Acting cool when it wasn't like me went 
well enough, but—

choice_data_list: T-Thirty-eight point two degrees...!!

text_block_list.text:
It seems it really was completely out of 
character for me. My body had felt 
strangely heavy since morning, but now my 
condition was rapidly deteriorating.

Through a haze of drifting consciousness, 
I pick up my smartphone, open the 
messaging app, and send a message to 
K.S.Miracle.
choice_data_list:
"Sorry, I need to take today off"... 
Ugh...

text_block_list.text:
Right after barely tapping the send 
button, my vision spun and blacked out.
And so—
Before I knew it, I was lying on the sofa.

How long had I been asleep? And when did I 
lie down on the sofa in the first place? 
Pondering this, I unconsciously rubbed my 
dry eyelids.

Just then, my hand brushed against 
something. ...It was a cooling sheet 
placed on my forehead.
choice_data_list: Ah... H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're awake. Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Can you drink it? It might be tough, 
but... staying hydrated is important.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'll help you sit up now.

Deftly assisted, I slowly sit up. The 
sports drink seeps blissfully into my 
parched body...

All the while, the fog that had hung over 
my mind finally began to clear, and 
then...
choice_data_list: Wait, Miracle?!?!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wah... Y-Yes, that's me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... I'm sorry for startling you. 
Even though I replied, it was never marked 
as read, and I had a bad feeling about 
it...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'm sorry for moving it on my own. 
But sleeping at the desk would make your 
body ache, so...
choice_data_list:
No, stop! It's contagious, you'll catch 
it!

text_block_list.text:
Stumbling yet in a rush, I scramble to my 
feet, pull a mask out of the drawer, and 
put it on.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I brought a mask too, so I'll put 
it on right away. I'll also make sure to 
wash my hands and gargle once I get home.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure not to catch it, I swear. 
...Can I stay for just a little bit 
longer?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please let me stay. I'm begging you. I 
want to—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to look at least a little cool.
choice_data_list: No, no, I couldn't possibly...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Then at least just one more thing. 
Could you let me do something?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Please tell me. Anything at all.

Her voice is so relentlessly gentle that I 
find myself giving in. It doesn't seem 
like she's going to back down either, so 
perhaps it's quickest to just order one 
thing...
choice_data_list:
Something to help you sleep better... or 
something like that?
...Could you grab some food for me?
...Could you grab some food for me?
Then, I'll put my work tools here...

text_block_list.text:
Her voice is so relentlessly gentle that I 
find myself giving in. It doesn't seem 
like she's going to back down either, so 
perhaps it's quickest to just order one 
thing...
choice_data_list:
Something to help you sleep better... or 
something like that?
...Could you grab some food for me?
...Could you grab some food for me?
Then, I'll put my work tools here...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I feel like... I could sleep well...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's not a tangible thing, but... can 
I do it the way I know how?

Then, after putting on a mask properly, KS 
Miracle knelt beside the sofa and placed a 
hand on my shoulder.

A cool, pleasant touch descends upon your 
shoulder at a steady rhythm... Tap... 
tap... tap...
Tap. ...Tap. ...Tap.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...This is all I have, but... How does it 
look...?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Trainer—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. Good night...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see, I believe jelly drinks and such 
were stocked on that shelf over there.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Also, I... bought some ice cream and 
pudding on my way here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Which one would you like? Please pick 
whichever one you prefer.

I had meant a jelly drink when I said 
that, so I hesitated for a moment... but 
not wanting to turn down their kindness, I 
ended up choosing the ice cream they 
bought for me.
choice_data_list: (Oh, this... I like this one.)
(Ah, this is... one of my favorites.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Did you like it after all? I had a feeling 
you might.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I won! Fufufu, I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I hope this... gives Trainer... lots of 
energy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Work, you say? Right now...?"
choice_data_list:
There's something I'd like to get a head 
start on...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Nnh, mm. ...I wonder if I can do it. I'm 
not really good at it, though...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ......Hey, now.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Let's rest, just for now. ...Okay?
